s3_readme.left_p1: Building software has never been just about writing lines of code or chasing the latest framework hype. It's about deeply understanding the core problem, modeling domain boundaries accurately, and delivering solutions that feel effortless /// from pixel to cloud infrastructure.
s3_readme.left_p2: I appreciate predictable systems that avoid hiding complexity beneath magic layers, and that genuinely respect the device resources of whoever is using them.
s3_readme.readme_intro: Developer at Arpa Sistemas, with a technical degree in Web Development from IFC. I won IFC's 1st Agro Hackathon and Consórcio Itá's 1st Science Fair, and I bring that drive to solve real problems to my own projects and freelance work.
s3_readme.readme_pillar_1: Real problems first: AgroInsights, Prisma, CICC and Energin came from concrete challenges, from farmers, business owners and a power plant.
s3_readme.readme_pillar_2: From sensor to screen: complete systems, with hardware reading the data, an API in the middle and a dashboard anyone can understand.
s3_readme.readme_pillar_3: Reuse before buying: Next Signage runs on screens headed for disposal, and CICC turns commutes into trees to plant.
s3_readme.readme_pillar_4: Accessible information: FAIF gathers open government data in one place, and teaching programming at SuperGeeks followed the same idea.
s3_readme.readme_now_text: Data processing with Apache Spark on Databricks, serverless architecture on AWS and, at work, Angular, Laravel and Supabase.
